Title: Now available: Azure Media Services' Video Indexer

Body.Content:
As part of this milestone, the Video Indexer service includes new functionality, such as new machine learning models – emotion detection, topic inference or custom languages among others, a new RESTful API (v2), and a new version of the connector for Azure Logic Apps and Microsoft Flow. 

Learn more
